errors.text: The claim that milling causes a VEC shift is physically unjustified: VEC is primarily composition-dependent, whereas milling changes strain, defect density, grain size, and chemical homogeneity.

Low-load Vickers hardness alone cannot isolate Hall–Petch strengthening from precipitation hardening; matched grain-size and phase-fraction controls or independent precipitate characterization are required.
The asserted 1050°C HCP-precipitation threshold and >10% HCP falsification criterion are not supported by the cited evidence or target result.
